name: o76438
description:
The security team has issued an advisory for **CVE-2025-12345: Remote Code Execution in ExampleApp**. This vulnerability is classified as **High** severity and carries a CVSS v3.1 base score of **9.8**. It was publicly disclosed on **2025-09-01**.

A critical remote code execution vulnerability in ExampleApp allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands via crafted HTTP requests. For further details and mitigation guidance, refer to the official entries at https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2025-12345 and https://security.example.com/advisories/2025-09.
